$comment: The three write invariants (AGENTS.md 'Write invariants') as data. `match` is an exact relative path, or an array of exact relative paths — every string may also be a glob (`*` any run of non-`/` characters, `**` any run including `/`) for a project that wants to widen a rule without editing the engine. `states` lists where the rule's verdict is always `allow`; `verdict` applies OUTSIDE that list. Rules are tried in order and the first match wins. Never edit this file in an install; it is replaced on upgrade — override from a project's own policy layer instead.

rules.reason: lessons are written at flow end; append during feature.compound, setup.apply, strategy.spec, or quick.verify
root .spec specs are writable only during strategy.spec, feature.compound, or setup.apply
state.json is written only via set-state.sh, never by direct edit
